note: Draft 1: hard pass (ids and marks). Soft flags, all accepted: 7:2 both cola −3 and 7:4 first colon −4 (‘Senhor, meu Deus’ is four syllables for the seven of Dómine, Deus meus); 7:3 first colon +4 (‘Para que não’ for Nequándo, articles); 7:7a second colon −3; 7:10 first colon +5 (the heaviest line: ‘Será consumida a maldade dos pecadores, e dirigireis o justo’ — two clauses in one colon, as the Latin has them; with its elisions it is about twenty syllables) and second colon +3 (‘vós que’ supplied); 7:16 second colon −3; 7:17 first colon +3; 7:18 second colon +4 (‘salmodiarei’). Every cadence is oxytone or paroxytone except the last word of the psalm, ‘altíssimo’, which has the Latin’s own stress (altíssimi) — decision altissimi. No rhyme flag.
